Advanced settings for experts. Warning: Incorrect configurations can cause the URL shortener to stop working.
Activates the Shr1nkr. After activation, you can create and manage short URLs.
Activate the visit counter for short URLs
Shows how many times a short URL has been accessed. The counter is displayed in the URL list and can be reset if needed.

On the redirect page, a button must first be clicked before redirecting to the target URL. This increases security and prevents automatic redirects. If "Delayed forwarding" is activated, the button can only be pressed after the waiting time has elapsed.
Displays a redirect page for the specified number of seconds before automatically redirecting to the target URL. Example: With "5", it waits 5 seconds. Set "0" for immediate redirect.

Caution: This setting should only be activated by experienced administrators. In expert mode, advanced options are unlocked that are not needed in most cases. Incorrect configurations can cause the Shr1nkr to stop working.
Shows more elements on the redirect page
On the redirect page, header, footer and all boxes are additionally displayed. By default, only a minimal redirect page without header/footer is shown.

Determines the length of the random hash code for short URLs. The longer the hash, the more different URLs are possible. Example: With a hash length of 4 characters, there are 1,679,616 different possibilities (36^4). Recommended: 4-8 characters.

An optional text that is inserted before each hash code. Example: With prefix "link-" and hash "abc", the URL /r/link-abc/ is generated. Important: The total length (prefix + hash) must not exceed 64 characters.
Only allows target URLs that start with <kbd>https://</kbd>. URLs with <kbd>http://</kbd> are rejected. This increases security by using encrypted connections.

Prevents target URLs that themselves redirect to other URLs (redirect chains). Example: URL A redirects to URL B, which in turn redirects to URL C. Such chains are blocked by default as they can cause problems.

Allows you to define a custom pattern (RegEx pattern) for hash codes. Default: [0-9a-z\-]{1,64} (numbers, lowercase letters and hyphens, 1-64 characters). Experts only: Incorrect patterns can prevent URLs from being created.

Overwrites the base URL for all generated short URLs. Example: With https://short.example.com, URLs like https://short.example.com/r/test/ are generated instead of https://example.com/urls/r/test/. Requires: Additional web server configuration (e.g. subdomain redirect). This option is only available in Expert Mode.
Installs demo URLs (DEMO-1 to DEMO-7) with example discounts, specials, featured links and custom buttons for testing purposes.

Removes the /shrinkr/ prefix from generated short URLs. Instead of /shrinkr/r/test/, /r/test/ will be generated. Requires manual webserver configuration. Important: Link rewriting must be enabled under "General".
Enables the reaction system for short URLs on the redirect page.
Allows guests to react on short URLs. Guest reactions are stored and synchronized with the user account upon registration.
Shows the share button on the redirect page.
Enables the display of descriptions on the redirect page. This setting overrides the individual activation/deactivation of single descriptions.
If enabled, users only need to enter the password for protected links once per session. After successful entry, access is stored for the current browser session.
The button automatically adapts to the promo badge colors.
Select a Font Awesome icon to display before the h1 title on the redirect page.
Allows theme-specific effects such as autumn leaves, snow or ghosts.
Enables the generation and display of QR codes in the URL list in the ACP.

Explanations of statistics, metrics and their calculation

The Shr1nkr statistics provide you with a comprehensive overview of the usage of your short URLs. All data is collected in compliance with GDPR: IP addresses are hashed with a daily salt, raw data is automatically deleted after the configured retention period. Aggregated statistics are retained permanently.
Number of visits today (since midnight). Each short URL access is counted.
Number of unique visitors today. Calculated based on hashed IP/User-Agent fingerprint.
Number of all interactions today (button clicks and reactions).
Conversion Rate: (Interactions / Visits) × 100. Shows what percentage of visitors click buttons or give reactions.
Average number of clicks/interactions per link.
The hour of the day (0-23) with the most visits.
Average time visitors spend on the redirect pages.
Shows which browsers and operating systems your visitors use. Detection is done via User-Agent.
Distribution of visits by device type (Mobile, Desktop, Tablet). Detection based on User-Agent patterns.
New visitors (first interaction) vs. Returning visitors (previously recorded). Based on hashed user fingerprint.
Shows which websites (referrers) visitors came from. "Direct Traffic" means no referrer is present (e.g., direct URL entry, bookmarks).
Clicks on the "Forward" button that leads to the actual target URL.
Clicks on custom buttons that you configured in the ACP settings.
Clicks on featured links (highlighted links), which can also be configured in the ACP.
Number of reactions (e.g., likes, emojis) given by visitors.
The Shr1nkr statistics collect personal data (IP addresses, user agents) only in anonymized form:
IP addresses are hashed using SHA-256 with a daily salt. Tracing back to the original IP is not possible.
Raw data (individual visits/interactions) is automatically deleted after the configured retention period.
Only aggregated statistics (daily/monthly summaries) are retained permanently.
